about_the_game:
Cosmodrill is a 2D open world space adventure in which drill through planets to gather valuable resources. Explore the galaxy, unveil its secrets and take on powerful enemies as you charter a path into the unknown!

Collect resources to upgrade your drill, unlocking new abilities and allowing you to dig deeper, travel farther, and face increasingly powerful foes. Along the way, you’ll discover space stations—once beacons of hope, now overrun by ruthless pirates. Liberate these outposts to rest, refuel, and push your mission forward.

No one knows exactly what the pirates are after... but one thing is certain: you’re the only one with the power to stop them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-633
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Explore the universe, dig deep into planets to find resources, upgrade your ship and survive against alien life in this 2D open-world space mining adventure! How far are you willing to travel into the dark unknown?
